import { it, expect, describe, beforeEach, afterEach, chai } from 'vitest';
import {body,createBodyRecorder} from './body.mjs';
it('[REQ-393][P01] empty',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>{}));
it('[REQ-393][P02] bare',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>{expect(1);}));
it('[REQ-393][P03] unreachable',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>{if(false)expect(1).toBe(1);}));
it('[REQ-393][P04] global',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1)));
it('[REQ-393][P05] context',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>ctx.expect({a:1}).toEqual({a:1})));
it('[REQ-393][P06] partial',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect({a:1,b:2}).toMatchObject({a:1})));
const extended=it.extend({value:async({},use)=>{expect(1).toBe(1);await use(1);expect(2).toBe(2);}});
extended('[REQ-393][P07] fixture-only',({task,onTestFinished,value})=>body({task,onTestFinished},()=>{void value;}));
extended('[REQ-393][P08] fixture-body',({task,onTestFinished,value})=>body({task,onTestFinished},()=>expect(value).toBe(1)));
describe('hooks',()=>{beforeEach(()=>{expect(1).toBe(1);setTimeout(()=>expect(1).toBe(1),3);});afterEach(()=>expect(2).toBe(2));
 it('[REQ-393][P09] hook-only',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>{}));
 it('[REQ-393][P10] hook-async',ctx=>body(ctx,async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,8));}));
 it('[REQ-393][P11] hook-body',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1)));
});
it.concurrent('[REQ-393][P12] concurrent global',ctx=>body(ctx,async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5));expect(1).toBe(1);}));
it.concurrent('[REQ-393][P13] concurrent context',ctx=>body(ctx,async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,6));ctx.expect(1).toBe(1);}));
it.concurrent('[REQ-393][P14] concurrent empty',ctx=>body(ctx,async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,7));}));
it('[REQ-393][P15] not',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(1).not.toBe(2)));
it('[REQ-393][P16] resolves',ctx=>body(ctx,async()=>{await expect(Promise.resolve(1)).resolves.toBe(1);}));
it('[REQ-393][P17] rejects',ctx=>body(ctx,async()=>{await expect(Promise.reject(1)).rejects.toBe(1);}));
it('[REQ-393][P18] soft pass',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect.soft(1).toBe(1)));
it('[REQ-393][P19] soft fail',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect.soft(1).toBe(2)));
it('[REQ-393][P20] poll',ctx=>body(ctx,async()=>{await expect.poll(()=>1).toBe(1);}));
it('[REQ-393][P21] snapshot',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toMatchInlineSnapshot('1')));
it('[REQ-393][P22] unknown matcher',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(true).toBeTruthy()));
let first=0;it('[REQ-393][P23] retry-last-empty',{retry:1},ctx=>body(ctx,()=>{if(++first===1)expect(1).toBe(2);}));
let second=0;it('[REQ-393][P24] retry-last-matcher',{retry:1},ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(++second).toBe(2)));
it('[REQ-393][P25] repeats',{repeats:2},ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1)));
let repeatRetry=0;it('[REQ-393][P26] repeats-retry',{repeats:1,retry:1},ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(++repeatRetry%2).toBe(0)));
it.fails('[REQ-393][P27] fails matcher',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(2)));
it.fails('[REQ-393][P28] fails unexpected pass',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1)));
it('[REQ-393][P29] nested',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1))));
it('[REQ-393][P30] sequential',async ctx=>{await body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1));await body(ctx,()=>expect(2).toBe(2));});
const secondBody=createBodyRecorder(chai);
it('[REQ-393][P31] double create',ctx=>secondBody(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1)));
it('[REQ-393][P32] opt-out',()=>expect(1).toBe(1));
it('[REQ-393][P33] catch',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>{try{expect(1).toBe(2)}catch{}}));
it('[REQ-393][P34] sync fail',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>{throw new Error('body-failure');}));
it('[REQ-393][P35] timeout',{timeout:12},ctx=>body(ctx,async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,35));expect(1).toBe(1);}));
it('[REQ-393][P36] wait late',ctx=>body(ctx,async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40));}));
it('[REQ-393][P37] finished throws',async ctx=>{await body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1));ctx.onTestFinished(()=>{throw new Error('finished-failure');});});
it.fails('[REQ-393][P38] fails finished throws',async ctx=>{await body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1));ctx.onTestFinished(()=>{throw new Error('finished-failure');});});
it.skip('[REQ-393][P39] skip',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1)));
it.todo('[REQ-393][P40] todo');
it('[REQ-393][P41] finished registered before body',async ctx=>{ctx.onTestFinished(()=>{throw new Error('finished-before');});await body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1));});
it.fails('[REQ-393][P42] fails finished registered before body',async ctx=>{ctx.onTestFinished(()=>{throw new Error('finished-before');});await body(ctx,()=>expect(1).toBe(1));});
it('[REQ-393][P43] invalid context callback once',()=>{let calls=0;try{body(undefined,()=>{calls++;throw new Error('intentional callback');});}catch{}expect(calls).toBe(1);});
it('[REQ-393][P44] return value',async ctx=>{let n=0;expect(await body(ctx,()=>{n++;return 42;})).toBe(42);expect(n).toBe(1);});
it('[REQ-393][P45] async return',async ctx=>{let n=0;expect(await body(ctx,async()=>{await Promise.resolve();n++;return 'done';})).toBe('done');expect(n).toBe(1);});
it('[REQ-393][P46] sync throw identity',async ctx=>{const error=new Error('original');let seen,n=0;try{await body(ctx,()=>{n++;throw error;});}catch(e){seen=e;}expect(seen).toBe(error);expect(n).toBe(1);});
it('[REQ-393][P47] async reject identity',async ctx=>{const error=new Error('original');let seen,n=0;try{await body(ctx,async()=>{n++;throw error;});}catch(e){seen=e;}expect(seen).toBe(error);expect(n).toBe(1);});
it('[REQ-393][P48] invalid context return',async()=>{let n=0;expect(await body(undefined,()=>{n++;return 9;})).toBe(9);expect(n).toBe(1);});
it('[REQ-393][P49] context getter error',async()=>{let n=0;const ctx={get task(){throw Error('unreadable');}};expect(await body(ctx,()=>{n++;return 7;})).toBe(7);expect(n).toBe(1);});
it('[REQ-393][P50] frozen metadata',async()=>{let n=0;const ctx={task:{meta:Object.freeze({}),result:{repeatCount:0,retryCount:0}},onTestFinished(){}};expect(await body(ctx,()=>{n++;return 5;})).toBe(5);expect(n).toBe(1);});
it('[REQ-393][P51] registration throws',async()=>{let n=0;const ctx={task:{meta:{},result:{repeatCount:0,retryCount:0}},onTestFinished(){throw Error('registration');}};expect(await body(ctx,()=>{n++;return 3;})).toBe(3);expect(n).toBe(1);});
it('[REQ-393][P52] recording write error',ctx=>body(ctx,()=>{if(ctx.task.meta.loomakeBody)Object.freeze(ctx.task.meta.loomakeBody.attempts[0].calls);expect(1).toBe(1);}));
